_comment: The adversarial case the source-line guard exists for. All five findings are individually well-formed and would pass schema validation untouched; each cites a real line of cmp-panel.lines.json and pairs it with a real value from a DIFFERENT row of the panel. Read row-major without layout, this is exactly what a model produces — and 'Potassium 139 mmol/L' in a medical record is a clinical emergency that never happened. Every case here is a cross-row mis-association: findings that cite no line or a line that does not exist are a different failure and are covered separately in extract.rs.
